Smaller EMI on a ₹2 lakh loan: why does it cost you ₹27,790 more?

Illustrative ₹2 lakh personal loan at 12% a year:
3 years: EMI ₹6,643, total interest ₹39,143.
5 years: EMI ₹4,449, total interest ₹66,933.
The lower EMI pays ₹27,790 more interest. A longer tenure can also come with a higher rate.

Did you pick your loan's tenure, or did the lender pick it for you?
